# SIGNVM

**A signet ring for the artificial age.**  
**Machines execute. Humans authorise.**

For five millennia the signet ring was the mandate of kings and queens. Today it returns as the only thing AI cannot fake.

Created by Jim Hannon-Tan (Alessi, Tom Dixon, LVMH, Flos). Founder of SIGNVM.

## The Core Problem

AI agents can book flights, execute trades, sign contracts and publish on your behalf. Nothing proves a conscious human authorised the action. SIGNVM is that proof — the deliberate physical seal.

## What it is

Precision-machined cryptographic signet ring (brass, sterling silver or 18K gold). The NFC antenna *is* the ring face itself. Embedded ARX HaLo chip registers to your LUKSO Universal Profile.  

AI agent proposes → you review → one tap → cryptographic signature. Action executes. Authorisation is on-chain, timestamped and irrevocable.

Edition 01 sculptural object already with Fabian Vogelsteller. The wearable signet ring is the refined evolution.

**Physical possession is the one primitive AI cannot simulate.**

## Who this is for

Founders deploying high-stakes AI agents • Developers building agent frameworks • Security architects needing human-in-the-loop ratification • Luxury collectors at the intersection of craft and sovereignty • Anyone who wants beautiful, meaningful control in the agentic age.

## The Technology

- Chip: ARX HaLo NFC (secp256k1 on-chip signing)  
- Identity: LUKSO Universal Profile (ERC-725) + LSP6 Key Manager (scoped permissions)  
- Multichain-ready: Base, Ethereum, Coinbase x402 and beyond via LSP16 factories  
- Manufacturing: Precision CNC + hand-finishing at ANFF Adelaide

## The Design Thesis

The infrastructure becomes jewellery. The spiral antenna is machined into the face. Over time the physical patina mirrors the on-chain history.

## Positioning

Machines execute. Humans authorise.  
A signet ring for the artificial age.
